ClinicalDocument.title: SYNTHETIC RECORD, NOT A REAL MEDICAL RECORD — Progress Note 6 — Focused Visit (Care-plan review) — Fannie Lou Hamer

code.originalText: Seven-month review: A1c, urine albumin, kidney function, seasonal and age-50 vaccines, screening results, and plans for the winter

text.paragraph: Seven-month review: A1c, urine albumin, kidney function, seasonal and age-50 vaccines, screening results, and plans for the winter. [S]

Mrs. Hamer returns five weeks after her preventive visit; she turned 50 this month. Her mammogram two weeks ago showed no abnormality, and her stool test, HIV and hepatitis C tests were negative. She went to the mammogram with the community health worker and said the technologist explained every step. Her home readings average 126/78. She takes metformin 1,500 mg with her evening meal without stomach trouble and has had no low blood sugar. Food and heating are covered for the winter, and the van has brought her to every visit. She asked about the vaccines due this autumn and what each one is for. [S]

list.item: Every examination, test and procedure explained first and done only with her documented agreement, with a chaperone of her choosing, at every visit. Outcome by 2026-10-19: Consent documented for every examination, blood draw, ultrasound, photograph, vaccine and screening test; she declined a breast and a pelvic examination, and that was respected [S]
Blood pressure below 130/80 mmHg in the clinic and at home within six months. Outcome by 2026-10-19: 124/76 in the clinic; home average 126/78 [S]
A1c below 7% within six to nine months, without low blood sugar. Outcome by 2026-10-19: 6.9% at seven months; no low blood sugar [S]
Urine albumin-to-creatinine ratio lower by at least 30% within six months. Outcome by 2026-10-19: 88 to 96 mg/g at baseline; 41 mg/g at seven months [S]

Food and utility needs met through benefits, and a dependable way to reach every visit and laboratory test. Outcome by 2026-10-19: SNAP and energy assistance in place; rides arranged for every visit after one missed laboratory check; transportation still uncertain on some days [S]
LDL cholesterol below 70 mg/dL. Outcome by 2026-10-19: 146 to 80 mg/dL on atorvastatin; recheck with the yearly panel [S]
